title: Pulse
description: A formation shooter. Arrows or A/D move; hold space to fire. Clear waves, dodge return fire, protect three shields.

rules.do: if (!state.over && count('alien') == 0 && state.scene == 'play') { state.wave += 1; state.dir = 1; repeat (24) { spawn('alien', {x: 70 + (i % 8) * 46, y: 60 + floor(i / 8) * 34, tags: ['alien'], fill: ['#b79aff','#ff7b9c','#7ee081'][floor(i / 8)]}) } }

do: state.cool -= dt; state.inv = max(0, state.inv - dt); self.opacity = state.inv > 0 && floor(time * 14) % 2 == 0 ? 0.3 : 1
if (held('fire') && state.cool <= 0) { spawn('shot', {x: self.x, y: self.y - 18, vy: -420, tags: ['shot'], data: {ttl: 1}}); state.cool = 0.2 }

rules.do: if (!state.over) { let edge = false; let enemies = all('alien'); repeat (count('alien')) { let e = enemies[i]; if ((e.x > W - 25 && state.dir > 0) || (e.x < 25 && state.dir < 0)) edge = true }; if (edge) { state.dir = -state.dir; repeat (count('alien')) enemies[i].y += 12 }; state.fireT -= dt; if (state.fireT <= 0 && count('alien') > 0) { let e = enemies[floor(rand(0, count('alien')))]; spawn('bolt', {x: e.x, y: e.y + 14, vy: 155 + state.wave * 12, tags: ['bolt'], data: {ttl: 3}}); state.fireT = max(0.22, 0.9 - state.wave * 0.08) } }
self.x += state.dir * (22 + state.wave * 7) * dt; if (self.y > 286) state.over = true
despawn(a); despawn(b); state.score += 20; sound('hit'); repeat (4) spawn('spark', {x: b.x, y: b.y, vx: rand(-80,80), vy: rand(-80,80), data: {ttl: 0.25}})
despawn(b); state.lives -= 1; state.inv = 1.2; sound('lose'); if (state.lives <= 0) state.over = true

if (state.over) { let e = all('shot'); repeat (count('shot')) e[i].vy = 0; e = all('bolt'); repeat (count('bolt')) e[i].vy = 0 }; let t = get('info'); if (t) t.text = 'WAVE ' + str(state.wave) + '   SHIELDS ' + str(state.lives)
